negative_reviews.author: jim gibb
negative_reviews.text: When you say on your website kitchen is open to 2200hrs then tell me at a 1930 hrs booking kitchen now closing at 2000 hrs because we 'not busy ' despite ten other mugs sorry punters being present dont ecpect a good review of a tip. The meal was obviously very rushed and unfortunately we could not get in anywhere else. So from a service perspective where the customer is not considered this is a zero experience However sad to say for this establishment which has the ambiance of an insurance office than a restaurant the food despite the expedited service was excellent The dynamite prawns were superb the goya dumplings fresh and tasty and the dragon roll sushi was first class.This continued to the mains where the simple Katsu curry deserves a standing ovation and the ramen broth alao received solid marks so after dropping 100£ plus for three covers i felt disheartened by the service appreciate everyone likes an warly night but please remember the customer

negative_reviews.author: YC wu
negative_reviews.text:
The food was as delicious as ever. However, the service provided by one of the larger-built male servers wearing a red shirt was very disappointing. Despite trying to get his attention several times, he repeatedly walked past our table without responding.

While clearing the table, he splashed some soup onto my shirt and left without acknowledging it or apologising. He may not have noticed, but he did not stay long enough for me to bring it to his attention.

The food was excellent as always, and the other staff members were friendly and attentive. Unfortunately, this particular service experience was disappointing, and I ended up leaving with a stained shirt.
